userInputText: StarBlast is an exciting and immersive multiplayer online game that takes players on an interstellar journey through space. In this game, players control customizable spaceships and engage in intense battles against other players from around the world. The objective is to eliminate opponents, collect power-ups, and upgrade their ship to become the most powerful force in the galaxy.
